statements: CREATE POLICY "playlist_track_default_admin_write_update" ON "public"."playlist_track" AS PERMISSIVE FOR UPDATE TO "public" USING ((SELECT (rebase.uid() IS NULL) OR (string_to_array(rebase.roles(), ',') && ARRAY['admin']))) WITH CHECK ((SELECT (rebase.uid() IS NULL) OR (string_to_array(rebase.roles(), ',') && ARRAY['admin'])));

policies.name: playlist_track_default_edge_read
statements: CREATE POLICY "playlist_track_default_edge_read" ON "public"."playlist_track" AS PERMISSIVE FOR SELECT TO "public" USING ((EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM "public"."playlist" "_ex0" WHERE "_ex0".playlist_id = "public"."playlist_track".playlist_id)) AND (EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM "public"."track" "_ex1" WHERE "_ex1".track_id = "public"."playlist_track".track_id)));
